decisions.rationale: Delivery of LZA/Control Tower desired-state config, specifically the audit/access log retention settings. config/global-config.yaml 'loggingRetentionDays' and the mirrored 'accessLogRetentionDays' are currently set to 365 (one year), carried from a spec example rather than an independent decision. Reference: plan.json step-desired-state, flagged IN-009 as a cost/compliance decision requiring approval, not silent inheritance. Refer to FedRAMP/NIST 800-53 AU-11 audit-record-retention requirement, customer/contractual data-retention clauses, and agency-specific ATO continuous-monitoring requirement. Risk: Under-retention (regulatory or contractual non-compliance) or over-retention (data-minimization/liability exposure) if 365 days does not match the governing requirement.
